blind_spots.blind_spot: The product pitch says 'Deploy on any infrastructure, including managed, multi-tenant' — pure commercial-cloud framing — while the company now sits on MDA's homeland-defense SHIELD IDIQ.
blind_spots.operator_reality: MDA task orders run on government-authorized enclaves at IL4/IL5, not generic 'any managed multi-tenant cloud.' Without a stated ATO/authorization roadmap, Protopia's own pitch to a missile-defense buyer reads like a SaaS deck dropped into a homeland-defense contract vehicle — exactly the mismatch that kills a transition after IDIQ selection but before a task order actually gets awarded.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Protopia's commercial motion (RSAC executive receptions, Q2 Bank/NetApp/UC San Diego case studies) is far more developed than its public DoD deployment story, suggesting the MDA win outran the deployment-architecture work needed to execute it.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Leverage GPUs in heterogenous environments – across on-prem, dedicated and multi-tenant implementations.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Every named customer persona in the pack is an enterprise executive (CIO, CISO, CDAO, Chief Data Scientist) — there is no operator, warfighter, or mission-user voice anywhere, including in the Navy demonstration mention.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A privacy layer that needs to run inline with missile-defense sensor or C2 data eventually needs a technical sponsor inside an operational unit, not just a CISO's sign-off — 'operators loving it' isn't even on the table here because operators are never mentioned; the advocacy chain stops at the enterprise buyer.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The company's GTM motion (RSA Conference cocktail receptions, partner blogs with ALTR/NetApp) is built for enterprise security-buyer sales cycles, which don't surface field-operator relationships the way an OT&E engagement would.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Leaders in AI Security, Data Privacy and Governance: You are invited to an Executive Cocktail Reception on Secure GenAI. ... Come meet with other CIOs, CISOs, CDAOs, CAIOs, CCOs, and Business Unit heads.

blind_spots.blind_spot: SGT is pitched as 'computationally lightweight' relative to data-center GPU inference economics (idle GPUs, TCO) — never relative to SWaP-constrained edge/sensor compute a missile-defense C2 node would actually run on.
blind_spots.operator_reality: 'Lightweight' next to an idle data-center GPU is a completely different bar than lightweight enough to run inline on a SWaP-C constrained sensor or edge processing node; the pack gives no evidence the team has tested or even discussed the latter case, despite the product's DoD relevance being precisely at the sensor/C2 edge.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The whole value proposition (per the pack) is framed around AI-factory/data-center GPU utilization economics, which is the opposite optimization target from edge SWaP-C.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: SGT holistically transforms the entirety of each data record using our patented technology into randomized representations ... work across data modalities, and are non-deterministic, irreversible and computationally lightweight.

opener_hook: You just landed on the Missile Defense Agency's $151B SHIELD IDIQ, but your own Stained Glass pitch is still framed entirely around AI Factory GPU idle-time and TCO — there's no ATO or IL4/IL5 authorization language anywhere on the site.
what_they_do: Privacy-preserving AI inference layer (Stained Glass Transform) that lets sensitive data flow into AI models without exposing plaintext, sold primarily to enterprise AI-infrastructure buyers, with an Air Force SBIR, a Navy pilot, and a new MDA SHIELD IDIQ award.
